name: MiseOS Orchestra Role Registry
description: Structured Mise Orchestra role, department, metaphor, and registry-binding metadata for the MiseOS Bootstrap Registry.

changePolicy.major: Human review required for ontology changes, department restructuring, or registry binding changes.
changePolicy.minor: Allowed for adding roles, mappings, and analytics fields.
changePolicy.patch: Allowed for wording, typo, and metadata corrections.

release.currentStrategy: Keep as internal registry data until MiseOS taxonomy stabilizes.
release.nextMilestone: Generate role cards and registry-lane dashboards.

answers.what: A structured role and metaphor data package for Mise Orchestra.
answers.does: Maps departments, characters, and culinary DevOps metaphors into machine-readable registry data.
answers.registry: GitHub npm registry under @mise-os after taxonomy review.
answers.changed: Added orchestra role/departments JSON and a package wrapper for programmatic loading.
answers.safe: Safe because it exposes static metadata only and requires review for taxonomy changes.
answers.agentExecutable: Yes, agents can load it to classify registry lanes and explain MiseOS roles.
